primitives.name: Deterministic Risk Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: 46 RISK, UNCERTAINTY, AND PROFIT explicitly.1 He and his opponents alike have failed to appreciate the fundamental difference between a determinate uncertainty or risk and an indeterminate, unmeasurable one.
primitives.assumptions: Risk is classified into measurable (determinate) and unmeasurable (indeterminate) categories.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_d approaches zero, risk becomes indeterminate and uninsurable.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian model assigns prior probabilities to R_d; GSE uses R_d to trigger adaptive state policies.
layer2.telemetry: Risk classification accuracy via insurance market behavior.

primitives.name: Insurable Risk Utility
primitives.verbatim_quote: Now a hittle consideration will show that there can be no considerable "irksomeness"attached to exposure to an insurable risk, for if there is it will be insured; hence there can be no peculiar income arising out of this alleged indisposition.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_i': 'utility of insurable risk, monetary units', 'I': 'insurance coverage, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Utility of insurable risk is zero when fully covered by insurance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I → 1, U_i → 0 due to complete risk mitigation.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes expected utility under insurance; GSE models agent behavior under full coverage.
layer2.telemetry: Insurance uptake rate as proxy for perceived irksomeness.

primitives.name: Risk Premium Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: If risk were exclusively of the nature of a known chance or mathematical probability, there could be no reward of risk-taking; the fact of risk could exert no considerable influence on the distribution of income in any way.
primitives.assumptions: Reward for risk-taking exists only when risk is not fully known.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_k → 1, P_r → 0 due to full predictability.

layer2.mapping: GSI evaluates P_r using variance of outcomes; GSE models income distribution shifts.
layer2.telemetry: Income inequality metrics correlated with risk premium variation.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that risk bifurcates into two domains: determinate (insurable) and indeterminate (non-insurable). Determinate risk allows for precise probabilistic modeling and insurance, while indeterminate risk cannot be quantified and thus cannot be priced or mitigated through standard financial instruments. This distinction implies that risk premiums arise only from indeterminate uncertainty, since known risks are priced into markets and do not generate additional returns. The utility of insurable risk vanishes when fully insured, indicating that risk aversion is only relevant where risk remains uninsurable. These primitives form a dual structure: one where risk is measurable and another where it is not, each with distinct implications for income distribution and decision-making.
